Phaëton (Lully) | Phaëton (LWV 61) is a "tragédie en musique" in a prologue and five acts by Jean-Baptiste Lully.  Philippe Quinault wrote the French libretto after a story from Ovid's "Metamorphoses".  It can be read as an allegorical depiction of the punishment awaiting those mortals who dare to raise themselves as high as the "sun" (i.e. the Sun King).
